question: In a certain language, if “SYSTEM” is written as “SYSMET” and “NEARER” is written as “AENRER”. How will “FRACTION” be written in the same code?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cbc5c097aeb98a48b72ad50b9d4e29b952906e3f76fa5d128ba82d4b9289f2b.png] 

**SYSTEM: SYSMET**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0847fb3e2f29479df583e7f35e1887535347def526c164a93ad59ca07f0c990f.png] 

**NEARER: AENRER**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a2f8bf9e8949ad531bda3ee5704ed5957f23ad69f267ed99e5205ea71f7807.png] 

Similarly,

**FRACTION: ?**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dbe7390f413b84c73ddb93c09798981e990dc1ac637796636660406339d3659.png] **

Hence, the correct answer is **"****CARFNOIT"**.
